What's inside.

dithercn is an open-source dither engine for shadcn/ui projects, with an agent skill that teaches your coding agent to use it. Everything installs as code in your repo.

The engine

dither-core installs into lib/dither as plain source you own. It turns a tone between 0 and 1 into dots with Bayer and blue-noise threshold matrices, then draws them three ways: a WebGL shader for anything that moves, SVG patterns and CSS masks for static fills, and a one-off pass for photos and logos. Colours come from your shadcn theme, animation pauses offscreen and respects reduced motion, and any dither exports to PNG, SVG or CSS.

The agent skill

A SKILL.md with references that teaches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and other coding agents to use the engine. It walks the agent through picking a technique, writing a field, placing the dither on a landing page or dashboard, colouring it from your theme, and checking it in a browser in light and dark mode at desktop and phone widths.

63 examples in 5 groups
Backgrounds 31

Full-bleed dithered surfaces for heroes, sections and cards. Dither gradient, Dither glow, Mesh gradient, Aurora and 27 more.

Charts 11

Charts and status displays with a dithered fill. Area chart, Bar chart, Line chart, Sparkline and 7 more.

Interface 12

Everyday interface pieces with a dithered finish. Dither button, Dither switch, Dither slider, Dither tabs and 8 more.

Text 4

Display text drawn, revealed or counted with a dither. Dither text, Dissolve text, Scramble text, Dither number.

Images 5

Your images and logos, dithered. Dither image, Image compare, Scroll reveal image, Dithered logo and 1 more.

One command, then ask.

Add the skill with the skills CLI, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any other agent. Your agent adds the engine the first time it builds a dither.

npm
yarn
pnpm
bun
$ pnpm dlx skills add https://dithercn.dev

What to ask your agent

Using shadcn? npx shadcn@latest add https://dithercn.dev/r/dithercn-skill.json installs the skill and the engine together. Installation has both commands.

fffuel is a collection of color tools and free SVG generators for gradients, patterns, textures, shapes & backgrounds

🚀 On fffuel you'll find a collection of free SVG makers to create cool backgrounds, seamless patterns, gradients, textures, shapes and blobs. Use the generated vector patterns directly on the web or in your favorite design app.

🤹‍♂️ The SVG and graphic creation tools on fffuel allow you to easily customize the final result so that the generated graphics are unique and fit with the rest of your design seamlessly.

✨ SVG stands for Scalable Vector Graphics and using SVGs on the web offers many benefits. For example, SVGs can be scaled to any size without ever losing visual quality, they can be edited later-on by tweaking the underlining markup and they can often be more lightweight than images that have been saved to a raster format like PNG or JPEG.

🔧 If you need to convert the generated SVGs over to PNG, you can use the SVG to PNG conversion tool.

🖼️ If you want to use the SVGs as background patterns, you can use the base64 encoder so that you can add the background images inline in your CSS.

🎨 Plus, I've also created some tools to help with converting color codes or picking great colors for your designs. For example, try out the color picker or the color palette generator.

What is this website about?

ambientCG is one of the largest sources for free PBR materials, HDRIs, and models for 3D art, architectural visualization, game development, VFX and more.

Today, ambientCG serves over 1,000,000 monthly downloads to hundreds of thousands of artists, students, and educators all over the world.

Why does ambientCG exist?

I started this website in 2018 to provide freely shareable 3D textures because I had become frustrated with the licensing policies of many other texturing platforms, which limit or forbid texture redistribution.

Are the assets really free for any purpose?

Yes. All assets are released under the Creative Commons CC0 license, making them free to use without attribution - even in commercial circumstances.

See the License page.

How can I support ambientCG?

If you'd like to support the project, you can become a patron on Patreon or buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.

Becoming a patron also includes perks such as ad-free browsing or early access.

Can I request a texture?

Not with a guarantee. If you are a patron, you can make texture suggestions, but I can't give any concrete promises and I don't do contract work at this point in time.

Can I get in touch?

You can find contact details and other legally required documentation here:

Imprint & Privacy Policy

Every site is captured from the live web at desktop and mobile sizes, broken into sections, and described with its typography, colours, platform, and components. Use it to compare how real teams solve the same design problem, then download a DESIGN.md brief to hand a reference to your team or an AI tool.

A curated library of hand-picked real website designs. Every site has full-page desktop and mobile captures, cropped sections, and the facts behind the design: industry, platform, typography, colours, and components.

New hand-picked sites are added daily. The Weekly Picks email collects the best of each week.

A short Markdown brief for one website or section, listing its typography, colours, components, and layout notes. Designers can share it with a team, and AI coding tools can read it as a design reference.

Every site is curated and hand-picked by an editor, and designers can suggest sites directly. Each one is reviewed before it is captured and published.

The Component Gallery is an up-to-date repository of interface components based on examples from the world of design systems, designed to be a reference for anyone building user interfaces.

COMPONENTS
View all
Carousel

Content slider

A means of displaying multiple slides of content, one or more at a time. Navigation between slides can be controlled via swiping, scrolling, or buttons.

Tree view

A component for displaying nested hierarchical information, such as a table of contents or directory structure.

Popover

An element that pops up from another element over other content; it differs from a tooltip in that it is usually triggered via click instead of hover and can contain interactive elements.

Rating

Ratings let users see and/or set a star rating for a product or other item.

Accordion

Arrow toggle, Collapse, Collapsible sections, Collapsible, Details, Disclosure, Expandable, Expander, ShowyHideyThing

An accordion is a vertical stack of interactive headings used to toggle the display of further information; each item can be 'collapsed' with just a short label visible or 'expanded' to show the full content.

Quote

Pull quote, Block quote

Quotes are used to display a quotation: either from a person or another outside source or to highlight a passage of the current document (a pull quote).

Pagination

Pagination is the process of splitting information over multiple pages instead of showing it all on a single page; also the name for the interface component used for navigating between these pages.

Tabs

Tabbed interface

Tabbed interfaces are a way of navigating between multiple panels, reducing clutter and fitting more into a smaller space.
